scope: GC-off diagnostic; identical own binary, bounded 512-request batches, no production tuning or performance acceptance. External load and frequency variation remain visible. Do not compare absolute numbers across prior cohorts.
conclusion: Turning off GC reduces instruction points by about seven percent in this cohort, while allocations remain about705 per request. It leaves a large instruction and CPU deficit versus Wasmtime. Collector removal alone cannot explain or close the observed gap; allocation, component operations, runtime transitions and guest code remain. Higher retained memory and unresolved short-window timing controls prevent a production ranking.

identity.mutations: No code changes; normal and no-GC runs share the exact same binary. GOGC=off is diagnostic only, with higher retained memory.
